prompts.01:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished premium portrait App Store screenshot for the English-language US political strategy game. Target canvas 1284 × 2778 pixels, exact if possible, tall iPhone App Store format (aspect ratio 0.4622). This is asset 01, the hero of a coordinated six-image series.
Input image 1 is a supporting insert: a REAL screenshot of the game. Preserve its actual app interface, wording, numbers, colors and layout faithfully inside a large crisp upright iPhone display. Do not invent app features or UI. Crop only the very bottom of the supplied screen if necessary. The game UI must occupy the majority of the lower two-thirds; no tiny illegible phone.
Art direction: prestigious political thriller, restrained midnight navy, warm ivory typography, antique gold accents, one vivid scarlet accent. Photographic marble US Capitol dome at dusk, small tasteful folded American flag fabric at an edge, subtle grain, rich shadows. The architectural art is atmospheric supporting marketing art, not a fabricated in-game 3D scene. No politician portraits, no official seals.
Layout: top 7% small tracked kicker “POLITICAL STRATEGY”; below, an enormous confident tightly set editorial headline in two lines, “LEAD” then “AMERICA.”, clean ivory with AMERICA lightly gold. Strong hierarchy readable at thumbnail size. Supporting line “Your decisions. A nation's future.” Clearly separate the typography area from the phone. Bottom 66%: a large nearly front-facing phone with the supplied real game screen, tasteful slim dark frame, occupying 83% of width, lifted by only a subtle shadow. Background landmark softly visible behind, keep screen legible.
Exact added copy only: “POLITICAL STRATEGY” / “LEAD” / “AMERICA.” / “Your decisions. A nation's future.” No install badges, no fake ratings, no awards, no pricing, no guarantees, no free claims, no extra text. Premium crafted marketing, not a generic SaaS template. Clean edges, no watermark. Single finished image, not a contact sheet.
prompts.04:
Use case: compositing / ads-marketing. Create ONE final App Store marketing screenshot, tall portrait target 1284×2778 pixels, aspect 0.4622. Asset 04 of a six-image premium US political strategy game series. Input image 1 is a REAL game screenshot to place faithfully into the composition; preserve its interface, all text, numbers, and icons. Do not invent gameplay or replace game text.
Design: midnight navy, ivory typography, antique gold and one restrained scarlet accent, fine photographic grain, cinematic Washington political-thriller editorial design. More sophisticated and quieter than a mobile game ad. Upper third has a giant bold ivory headline aligned left, exactly:
“YOUR POLICIES.”
“THE HEADLINES.”
Below in smaller refined type exactly: “The country reacts to every choice.”
Small tracked kicker at very top: “AMERICA IS WATCHING”
Below headline: a very large nearly front-facing upright iPhone frame containing the supplied game screenshot, crisp and legible, most of lower two-thirds, about 84% canvas width, screen slightly extending beneath bottom edge if needed. The real game screen is the main product proof. Support it with soft-focus monochrome newspaper printing presses and stacked newspapers around the edges, subtle red editorial rule, gold rim light. Newspapers must NOT have legible invented claims, names or headlines. Keep app screen unchanged, no third-party logos, no portraits, no official seals.
Exact added typography only as quoted, no ratings, fake awards, prices, install badges or further claims. Good contrast at thumbnail size. Final single poster, no collage or contact sheet, no watermarks.
